note: R2-B repaired challengers. Definitions are FROZEN; only `retrospective_results` is written by src/studies/r2_repaired_challengers.py. RETROSPECTIVE evidence is never mixed with forward evidence and never promotes anything.

common.promotion: NONE - research only; retrospective results are never automatic justification for cutover

code.commit: recorded per run in each result JSON (v9_commit)

versions.recency: r2-recency-1.0, PRIMARY season_age {0:4,1:3,2:2,3:1.5,else 1}, frozen before evaluation

common.cutoff: rows strictly before the CI run date (UTC); recorded per run
common.blocks: holdout = rows on/after HOLDOUT_START (newest ~20% of the task rows, whole-date cut, identical for every arm); pre-holdout base 80% / calibration 10% / meta 10%, whole-date cuts, disjointness asserted

baseline.definition: legacy_v9 recipe exactly as pipeline.mode_train trains it (legacy build_features, the serving payload feature list, TRAINING_DECAY_WEIGHTS season-label weights, src.model.train) split at the same holdout boundary
baseline.caveat: its meta-logistic is fitted ON the holdout (bug 6) so its holdout number is optimistic; CHAMPION_BASEMEAN (calibrated base models averaged, no meta) is the clean legacy reference

metrics.primary: holdout log loss of the SERVED probability (meta blend), challenger minus baseline, 95% matchday block-bootstrap CI
metrics.market: ONLY genuine two-sided pre-kickoff ENTRY prices, proportional de-vig, negative-margin pairs excluded; never synthetic side prices, never closing, never one-sided; NF summer-2026 window and NF O1.5/O3.5 before 2026-08-23 excluded (non-full-match lines)

common.retrospective_verdict_rule: delta LL CI95 entirely < 0 -> REPAIRED_BETTER_RETROSPECTIVE; entirely > 0 -> REPAIRED_WORSE_RETROSPECTIVE; else NO_DIFFERENCE_RETROSPECTIVE

requires: SHADOW serving path with identical train/serve features and the persisted imputer
FORWARD_ACCRUAL from first sight (never retrospective rows); live evidence only from 2026-09-01 and after shadow start
PG-1.0 prospective rule: n >= 1000 settled first-sight rows per track
served-probability log loss delta vs the serving champion with 95% CI entirely below 0 on prospective rows
ECE not worse than the champion by more than 0.01
no data-integrity, parity or identity health FAIL during accrual
never: market metrics on synthetic or closing prices

pooled_variants: every SIDE experiment trains pooled, Standard-only and NF-only challengers on the same holdout boundary; pooled-vs-track is reported in the results (finding 19)

definitions.MODERN_ARCHIVE: all rows from the first archive date on, uniform
definitions.RECENT_2: last two derived seasons before the holdout, uniform
definitions.RECENT_3: last three derived seasons before the holdout, uniform

source_regimes.tasks: nf_ou25 (newformat) and every side market on standard and newformat

arms.A: current hand-typed priors (HA 0.55/0.45, away goals 1.10, SOT 0.35/0.33, HT 0)
arms.D: NaN + global train median + missing indicators

standard_cold_start_finding_16.status: RESEARCH ONLY - Standard production is not modified until evaluated and owner-approved

experiments.hypothesis: A New Format O/U 2.5 model on the repaired architecture (identity-canonical NF history, as-of league-scoped features with the Nov-1 NF parity semantics, no market feature, train-only imputer, four chronological blocks, derived recency) is at least as well calibrated as the legacy NF recipe on the untouched holdout, while removing batch dependence and the holdout-fitted meta.
A Standard-only BTTS repaired challenger scores at least as well as the pooled legacy side model on Standard holdout rows (finding 19: pooling with New Format may be wrong).
A New-Format-only BTTS repaired challenger scores at least as well as the pooled legacy side model on New Format holdout rows.
Standard-only Over 1.5 repaired challenger vs pooled legacy, Standard holdout rows.
New-Format-only Over 1.5 repaired challenger vs pooled legacy, New Format holdout rows.
Standard-only Over 3.5 repaired challenger vs pooled legacy, Standard holdout rows (research only; O3.5 betting stays inactive).
New-Format-only Over 3.5 repaired challenger vs pooled legacy, New Format holdout rows (research only).

An HT Over 0.5 challenger on the repaired architecture (repaired as-of features + src.ht_features run per league so team accumulators cannot cross competitions) is at least as well calibrated as the legacy HT recipe on the untouched holdout.
